title: AmbientClinical
description: Intelligent AI-powered medical note generator and doctor's clinical dashboard.
longDescription: AmbientClinical is an advanced AI system designed for healthcare professionals. It automatically captures and records physician-patient conversations, generating comprehensive SOAP notes, prescriptions, and ICD-11 codes. The platform includes a real-time analytics dashboard, diagnosis trends, and quick-action tools to streamline clinical workflows.

title: Hydrogen Baja Competition
description: Hydrogen–Petrol dual-fuel engine system with real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance.
longDescription: Developed an intelligent Hydrogen–Petrol dual-fuel engine system that enables smooth fuel switching, monitors performance in real-time, predicts maintenance needs, and improves efficiency, reliability, and safety.

title: Jarvis AI Assistant
description: Voice-only AI assistant with a single input field that gives concise, one-line responses.
longDescription: Voice-only AI assistant with a minimal UI that gives concise responses using Gemini LLM and Web Speech API, with real-time speech recognition and text-to-speech feedback.

title: Distance Measurement System
description: An IoT-based system to measure distance accurately using ultrasonic sensors and microcontrollers.
longDescription: This project uses ultrasonic sensors and an Arduino microcontroller to measure and display precise real-time distances with calibrated threshold triggers and LED indicators.

title: Resume Analyzer
description: A smart RAG tool to analyze resumes and extract key information using LLMs.
longDescription: Developed a resume analyzer using Streamlit, LangChain, and Ollama that extracts key skills, experience, and contact info from PDF resumes, giving match scores for job descriptions.

title: F1 RoadMap Tracker
description: A tool to track and analyze F1 race data, driver stats, and season roadmaps.
longDescription: Developed a comprehensive tool to track and analyze Formula 1 race data, providing telemetry insights into driver performance, lap times, and race strategy predictions.

title: MScart
description: An e-commerce platform for buying and selling products online with secure payment.
longDescription: Developed an e-commerce platform that allows users to browse products, manage carts, and make secure transactions online with Stripe checkout and MongoDB storage.

title: Cyber Shield
description: Intelligent AI-powered phishing detection system with real-time multi-engine analysis.
longDescription: Cyber Shield is an advanced security platform designed to detect and prevent phishing attacks in real-time. It integrates Gemini AI for semantic reasoning, VirusTotal for file/URL intelligence, and AbuseIPDB for IP reputation analysis.

title: Trust Bite
description: Blockchain-powered food supply chain transparency and safety monitoring system.
longDescription: Trust Bite leverages blockchain and IoT to ensure food safety and transparency throughout the supply chain. It provides real-time tracking of food origins and storage conditions to build consumer trust.

title: Birthday Wish
description: A personalized, interactive digital birthday celebration platform with animations.
longDescription: An engaging web-based platform for sending and experiencing personalized birthday wishes, featuring interactive elements, particle effects, and smooth animations.

title: Safe Flow
description: Intelligent industrial fluid management and safety monitoring system.
longDescription: Safe Flow is a hybrid engineering solution designed for industrial environments to monitor fluid flow, detect leaks, and ensure operational safety using real-time sensor data.
